manual.title: XIV Dye Tools Manual
manual.welcome: Welcome to **XIV Dye Tools**! This bot helps you explore and match FFXIV dye colors.
manual.commandsIntro: Below you'll find all available commands organized by category.

extractor.name: `/extractor color <color> [count]` | `/extractor image <image> [colors]`
extractor.description:
Match colors to FFXIV dyes.
• `color`: the closest dyes to a hex code or dye name (`count` 1-10)
• `image`: the dominant colors of an uploaded image (`colors` 3-10)

harmony.name: `/harmony <color> [type] [wheel] [companions]`
harmony.description:
Generate harmonious dye combinations.
• 10 types: Complementary, Analogous, Triadic, Split-Complementary, Tetradic, Inverted Tetradic, Square, Monochromatic, Compound, Shades
• 5 color wheels: RGB, RYB, Munsell, OKLCH hue, OKLCH lightness

mixer.name: `/mixer <dye1> <dye2> [mode]`
mixer.description:
Blend two dyes together using color science.
• 6 blending modes: RGB, LAB, OKLAB, RYB, HSL, Spectral
• Blends at five ratios and finds the closest dye to each

gradient.name: `/gradient <start_color> <end_color> [steps] [color_space]`
gradient.description:
Create a color gradient between two colors, with a matched dye for each step.
• 2-12 steps (default 6)
• 9 color spaces (default HSV)

swatch.name: `/swatch <file> [order] [slot]`
swatch.description:
Match a character's colors to dyes from a `.chara` file (Anamnesis or Ktisis).
• Reads skin, hair, highlights, eyes, lip, face paint and tattoo/limbal ring
• `slot`: the five nearest dyes for one color

preferences.name: `/preferences show` | `/preferences set [option] …` | `/preferences reset [key]` | `/preferences filters set|show|reset`
preferences.description:
Manage your bot preferences.
• `set`: language, blending, matching, result count, clan/gender, world, card values, theme
• `filters`: leave dye groups out of results
• `reset`: one setting, or everything

dyeSearch.name: `/dye search <query>`
dyeSearch.description:
Search for dyes by name.
• Partial names match, in English or your language
• Shows each match's hex code

dyeInfo.name: `/dye info <name>`
dyeInfo.description:
Get detailed information about a specific dye.
• HEX, RGB, HSV and LAB values
• Source, market item and nearest dyes

dyeList.name: `/dye list [category]`
dyeList.description:
List all dyes or filter by category.
• Categories: Reds, Browns, Yellows, Greens, Blues, Purples, Neutral, Special

dyeRandom.name: `/dye random [unique_categories]`
dyeRandom.description:
Show 5 randomly selected dyes.
• Option to limit to 1 dye per category

comparison.name: `/comparison <dye1> <dye2> [dye3] [dye4]`
comparison.description:
Compare 2-4 dyes side by side with color analysis.
• Accepts dye names or hex codes

contrast.name: `/contrast <dye1> <dye2> [dye3] [dye4]`
contrast.description:
Measure WCAG contrast ratios between 2-4 dyes.
• Marks the 3:1, 4.5:1 and 7:1 lines

accessibility.name: `/accessibility <dye> [dye2] [vision]` | `/a11y`
accessibility.description:
See how dyes hold up under color vision deficiency.
• One dye: how it shifts under every lens
• Two dyes: how far apart they stay (`vision` picks one lens)
• `/a11y` is the same command

budget.name: `/budget find <target_dye> [world]` | `/budget quick <preset> [world]` | `/budget set_world <world>`
budget.description:
Find affordable alternatives to an expensive dye using market board prices.
• `find`: cheaper dyes near your target (`max_distance` 2-20)
• `quick`: the same for popular expensive dyes
• `set_world`: save your world or data center

presetBrowse.name: `/preset list [category] [sort]` | `/preset show <name>` | `/preset random [category]`
presetBrowse.description:
Browse community dye presets.
• 8 categories
• Sort by most popular, most recent or name

presetShare.name: `/preset submit <preset_name> <description> <category> <dye1> <dye2> <dye3>` | `/preset edit <preset>` | `/preset vote <preset>`
presetShare.description:
Share your own presets and vote on others.
• 3-6 dyes plus optional tags; submissions are moderated
• `edit` works on your own presets

presetFavorite.name: `/preset favorite add <preset_name>` | `/preset favorite remove <preset_name>` | `/preset favorite list`
presetFavorite.description: Keep a personal list of favorite presets (up to 50).

changelog.description:
Show what's new in the bot.
• The latest release in full, or pick one with `version`

stats.description: Show bot usage statistics. Panels other than `summary` are limited to authorized users.

matchImageHelp.title: Matching Colors from an Image
matchImageHelp.description: `/extractor image` analyzes an uploaded image, pulls out its dominant colors and matches each one to the closest FFXIV dye. Here are some tips to get the best results!
matchImageHelp.howItWorksContent:
**1. Image Analysis**
- Your image is processed using K-means clustering
- The most dominant colors are extracted (`colors` 3-10, default 4)

**2. Dye Matching**
- Each color is matched against all 125 FFXIV dyes
- Uses ΔE2000 by default - change it with the `matching` option
- The card lists the five largest colors; its color bar shows them all
matchImageHelp.tipsContent:
**Crop Your Images**
- Focus on the specific area you want to match
- Remove UI elements and backgrounds

**Choose Good Lighting**
- Take screenshots in well-lit areas
- Avoid dark shadows or extreme highlights

**Avoid Dark Backgrounds**
- Black backgrounds can skew results
- Use neutral, lighter backgrounds when possible
matchImageHelp.commonIssuesContent:
**"I got a dark color but my gear is bright!"**
→ Your background is likely dark. Crop the image to just your gear.

**"The match seems off"**
→ The algorithm picks the MOST common colors. Crop out everything else.

**"Can I match a specific part?"**
→ Yes! Crop to that exact area before uploading.
matchImageHelp.proTipsContent:
• Use image editing software to crop before uploading
• For metallic/shiny gear, results may vary
• If you know the hex code, use `/extractor color` instead
• Ask for more or fewer colors with the `colors` option (3-10)
• Screenshot at 1920x1080 or higher for best quality
matchImageHelp.footer: XIV Dye Tools - Made with love for FFXIV glamour enthusiasts
matchImageHelp.goodExamplesContent:
• Cropped screenshot of a single chest piece
• Close-up of dyed armor with neutral background
• Screenshot taken in bright daylight area
• Image focused on the color you want to match
matchImageHelp.poorExamplesContent:
• Full-screen screenshot with lots of UI
• Character in a dark dungeon or cave
• Multiple armor pieces with different dyes
• Image dominated by background colors
matchImageHelp.whenToUse: When to Use /extractor image vs /extractor color
matchImageHelp.whenToUseContent:
**Use `/extractor image` when:**
• You have a screenshot and want to find the dye
• You're unsure of the exact color code
• You want to match a color from inspiration photos

**Use `/extractor color` when:**
• You already know the hex color code
• You need more precise/exact results
• You're working with color swatches
matchImageHelp.matchQualityRatingsContent:
Every listed match prints its distance from your color - lower is closer.

The six matching methods and how their bands work: `/manual` topic {topic}
matchImageHelp.poweredBy: Powered by Photon WASM image processing

firstRun.title: XIV Dye Tools 5.0
firstRun.body: This bot was redesigned: new cards, a suite-wide matching vocabulary (ΔE2000 default), /contrast and /a11y, and a character-file /swatch. See /manual for the tour, /changelog for what changed, and /preferences to make it yours. This notice shows once.

changelog.title: What's new in the bot
changelog.empty: The changelog is unavailable right now.

colorVision.name: Colour Vision
colorVision.body: The accessibility tools simulate four lenses — protanopia (PROT), deuteranopia (DEUT), tritanopia (TRIT) and achromatopsia (ACHR) — using the Brettel method, then measure how far apart two dyes remain under each lens. Larger separation is safer: the bands read 30 / 15 / 8 under ΔE2000.

contrast.name: Contrast
contrast.body: /contrast measures WCAG luminance ratios between dyes (1:1–21:1). The non-text floor is 3:1 (WCAG 2.1, criterion 1.4.11); the frames mark 3 / 4.5 / 7 and name bands by their ratio — no letter grades. Ratio measures lightness only, not colour difference.

matchingMethods.name: Matching Methods
matchingMethods.body: Six methods, one vocabulary: ΔE2000 (default), ΔEOK2, ΔE76, REDMEAN, RGB DIST and DISTINGUISH %. Only ΔE2000's bands follow your match line; every other method's bands are fixed, tiers are never compared across methods, and the method prints wherever a tier appears.

spectrumPrices.name: Spectrum & Prices
spectrumPrices.body: Since Patch 7.5, 105 of the 125 dyes share three market items: Standard Spectrum Dye (216 gil at the vendor — the one price that cannot move), Wide Spectrum #1 (Skybuilders' Scrips) and Wide Spectrum #2 (Cosmocredits). A consolidated dye has no listing of its own, so /budget prices the group, never the dye.

characterFile.name: Character File
characterFile.body: /swatch reads a .chara export from Anamnesis or Ktisis: colour slots (skin, hair, highlights, eyes, lip, face paint, tattoo/limbal ring) and worn gear dyes. The file is read once to build the reply and is not stored. Off-grid colours (edited past the game's palette) are matched by their live value and flagged OFF GRID.
